glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 辵 (“walk”) + phonetic 睘 – to go back; to return.
senses: [huán] to return to a place; to go back to a place
[huán] to return an object; to give back
[hái] still; yet; indicates that the phenomenon or observation still exists or the action is still o …
[xuán] (obsolete in standard Chinese) alternative form of 旋 (“to rotate; to turn around”)
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 還; s_page_origin explains the simplified 还.
